question: On volume 56 pg 195, does the "shuu wakki- masserri" thing Buggy says mean something like "open sesame"? LOVE
answer: Um, that is--. I don't really know much about this, haven't you heard before? Those Christian kids saying "shuu wakki- masserri ♪" in a church. If you suddenly hear it, it's hard to understand, but it means "shu wa kimaseri" ("here comes our holy master" in a Japanese song) and I had the godlike Buggy sing it. (haha) It's like for fun. The title is something like "come here many peoples". Bored people can look it up.
name: Ace LOVE
